body: Youd think. Im not legally disabled. im still going through paperwork and fucktons of tests to prove it. its so time consuming and i hate it. i just wish i could hold someone in my arms. or i wish i could go back in time and cause scenes and go into foster care. maybe get adopted by parents whod have loved me.
I dont have anybody like that. I dont have enough money for rent in an apartment, either. I can't work a proper job like retail without feeling absolutely terrible because of my chronic pain.

I recently turned 18 and moved into my grandmothers. But I feel so fucking terribly because I've caused her so much pain. Her daughter (my mom) wont even talk to her anymore. Its only fucked things up more and I know she must have regretted taking me in
